question: Can anything other than the enumerated writers reach 0x800823A0 or 0x80082470?
scope: every code function in every analysed image: the index's range_type=='code' records, including the promoted target-root island 0x8004C898 (its 20 bytes and 2 register-based stores left the uncensused complement on 2026-08-06). That IS a criterion -- it excludes 54 thunk records (one of which holds a resolved store, to 0x80080E68, outside both windows), 78 data records, and 35,192 gap bytes in no census record across ALL 21 loaded-image ranges -- 34,208 in SCUS_942_88, 424 in MEMORY, 560 across five level overlays -- (file-universe complement 37,316 bytes; the two differ by the nonresident header prefixes). A third-party sweep on 2026-08-06, over its then-current 47,420-byte uncensused complement, found 351 stores and 1,016 loads there and ZERO window-reaching accesses, so the exclusion is bounded rather than merely disclosed. Set, ends and image table are generated from the static index (tools/phase4_gen_resolver_extents.py); the census itself is the remaining trust root
unresolved_sites_scope: window-touching extents only -- the corpus-wide residual is in the corpus block

corpus.comment: the completeness claim, over EVERY code function in EVERY analysed image -- no selection

window_touching.comment: the item-2 blocker denominator: extents the corpus scan RESOLVED an access into a window. Discovered, not declared -- but discovered from RESOLVABLE accesses only, so a function whose sole window access goes through an unrecoverable base does not enter this denominator. Conservative for the safety claim (which is corpus-wide), deflating for the residual.

top_level_keys_scope: window-touching extents. The corpus-wide equivalents are in the corpus block and are much larger; do not quote these two as a property of the image.
claim: No additional writer among the RESOLVED accesses, over the WHOLE CORPUS (33644 accesses in 1059 extents). But 5656 unresolved store sites remain corpus-wide (238 of them in the 37 extents that reach a window); this pass cannot exclude any of them, so the writer set is NOT shown to be complete.
residual: UNKNOWN sites keep a base this pass could not recover (argument pointers, memory-loaded pointers, call results). They are NOT argued to be disjoint.
